candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its downstream order call times out: traces show POST order and POST payment failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), while inventory/redis calls succeed in ms. The order service's payment dependency stalls, propagating latency to the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order/payment not directly observed; only gateway-side client timeouts and topology are available.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s correlate with ~2s transport ReadTimeouts on the order and payment calls, while inventory/redis succeed quickly. This points to downstream latency in the order->payment path rather than a gateway-local fault. Order/payment-side telemetry is missing to fully localize the stall.
missing_evidence: Order and payment service traces/logs to confirm where the ~2s stall originates
Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm the ReadTimeout source
Order service dependency operation metrics (currently empty series)
